name: Liesl van der Hoven
reason: Too thin once the rules are applied: her site (Here, your Heart; base Strand, Cape Town) has had no new content since February 2022, offers no current classes or courses, both her books are about children's anxiety (health-claim rule), several free resources are anxiety-led, and her Insight Timer profile is an empty script page with curl; what remains is children's colouring pages and a few affirmation posts.
